about: An event's payload carries an enum field, the variant's declared name as a JSON string. A guard compares it with `===` to a variant and an assignment stores it in a variable of the same enum, so a screen shown as a week is held as a week and one shown as an agenda, a variant spelled with an underscore, is saved as the name the document wrote. A name the enum does not declare, or a value that is no name, does not fit the schema: the delivery is refused and writes nothing. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: each variable starts at the value its expr names
a week: the guard on the agenda is false, the second transition stores the layout and the zoom
an agenda: the variant named with an underscore takes the first transition
a day after an agenda: the agenda flag is written again
the month it started at, from the payload this time
a name the enum does not declare is no value of it: the delivery is refused as a payload that does not fit its schema, and nothing is written
a number is no name: refused the same way
a well formed payload after a refused one is read as any other
